Name: Functional Skincare
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
✨ [b]Skincare Fridge & Skincare Products[/b] ✨
This mod adds a skincare fridge and 20 usable skincare products to Stardew Valley.

🧴 [b]Skincare products[/b]
The mod includes [b]face masks, eye patches, cleansers, tonics, serums, moisturizers, and sunscreen[/b].
All skincare products restore 25 Energy and temporarily appear on your character.
Right click a skincare product to use it. No need for fs hand mirror.
The item is consumed, the effect is applied, and the visual fades away automatically when it ends.
🧊 [b]Skincare Fridge[/b]
The Skincare Fridge is a furniture catalogue item that can be bought from Robin's (The carpenter) shop.

📦 [b]Requirements
[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] is required for visuals, but the mirror is not required
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] 

📥 [b]How to install[/b]
Download and unzip the mod.
Place all the 4 folders into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. Don't merge the contents of the folders with each other. They should exist seperately.
Example path
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

Downloads.Description: Version 1.01. The skincare effects are now compatible with other fs mod appereances and they won't be cleared out once the effect of the product fades away except the ones in the "accessory" category due to fs skincare sprites being in that category.
